name.en: Building finals and Certificate of Occupancy
name.zh: 建筑终验与入住许可证（CofO）

agency.en: City of Phoenix Planning and Development Department, Inspections Division
agency.zh: 凤凰城规划与发展局 检查处

when.en: When the project is complete, including off-site (right-of-way) and on-site improvements. Maricopa County's health final needs this Final or Certificate of Occupancy first.
when.zh: 工程全部完工时进行，包括场外（公共道路范围）和场内的配套工程。马里科帕县的卫生终验需要先取得这项终验或入住许可证。

book.en: Request by phone on the Automated Inspection Request System (AIRS) at 602-495-0800, online in the Online Permitting System using the key number printed on your permit receipt, or with an agent at 602-262-7811 (8 a.m.–5 p.m.).
book.zh: 可拨打自动检查预约系统（AIRS）602-495-0800，或在网上许可系统中用许可证收据上的 key number 预约，也可在早 8 点至下午 5 点致电 602-262-7811 由客服预约。

lead.en: Requests made before 9 p.m. are scheduled for the next business day.
lead.zh: 晚上 9 点前提交的预约排在下一个工作日。

failNext.en: The contractor gets a red tag listing what must be fixed; after fixing it, call for a reinspection.
failNext.zh: 承包商会收到列明问题的红色标签；整改后再预约复检。

item.en: Structural (199), plumbing (298), mechanical (299) and electrical (399) finals have all passed.
item.zh: 结构（199）、给排水（298）、机械（299）和电气（399）终验全部通过。

item.en: Kitchen exhaust (254) and backflow prevention (236) inspections have passed where the plans include them.
item.zh: 图纸中包含的厨房排风（254）和防回流（236）检查已通过。

item.en: The fire final (999) has passed; it is required for the Certificate of Occupancy.
item.zh: 消防终验（999）已通过，这是取得入住许可证的前提。

item.en: Off-site and on-site improvements are complete, and the site final (899) has passed if the project has site work.
item.zh: 场外和场内配套工程已完工；如有场地工程，场地终验（899）已通过。

item.en: The approved plans are on site; the inspector checks the work against them and city codes.
item.zh: 批准图纸放在现场，检查员据此及市政法规核查。

item.en: When every required inspection passes, a Certificate of Occupancy is generated automatically if the project needs one; otherwise you get a green tag.
item.zh: 所有必检项目通过后，需要入住许可证的项目会自动生成；不需要的项目则发放绿色合格标签。

name.en: Fire inspections for new construction and fire final
name.zh: 新建工程消防检查与消防终验

agency.en: City of Phoenix Planning and Development Department, fire inspections under the Phoenix Fire Code
agency.zh: 凤凰城规划与发展局（依据凤凰城消防法规执行消防检查）

when.en: Alongside the building inspections. The final fire inspection (999) comes after every life safety component is complete and is required for the Certificate of Occupancy.
when.zh: 与建筑检查同步进行。消防终验（999）在所有生命安全设施完工后进行，是取得入住许可证的前提。

book.en: Call the area fire inspector listed on your fire permit. If the permit has no contact, call the Planning and Development line at 602-262-7811.
book.zh: 直接致电消防许可证上列明的片区消防检查员。若许可证上没有联系方式，请拨打规划与发展局电话 602-262-7811。

lead.en: At least 48 hours' notice; the contractor must be on site.
lead.zh: 须至少提前 48 小时预约，承包商须在场。

item.en: Automatic hood system (918) for the commercial kitchen is inspected.
item.zh: 商用厨房的自动排烟罩灭火系统（918）已检查。

item.en: Sprinkler systems have passed the mandatory 200 psi pressure test (921).
item.zh: 喷淋系统已通过强制性 200 磅压力测试（921）。

item.en: Sprinkler final (923) is done after the mandatory testing and engineering reports.
item.zh: 喷淋终验（923）在强制测试和工程报告完成后进行。

item.en: The control panel and alarm monitoring (dialer, 927) are inspected.
item.zh: 控制面板及报警监控（拨号器，927）已检查。

item.en: Alarm final (933): notification to the alarm devices, and audible and visual indicators, all work.
item.zh: 火警终验（933）：各报警装置联动正常，声光报警均有效。

item.en: Magnetic locks or delayed egress, if installed, pass access control final (971).
item.zh: 如装有电磁锁或延时疏散装置，已通过门禁终验（971）。

item.en: Final fire inspection (999) is passed after all life and safety components are built.
item.zh: 所有生命安全设施完工后，通过消防终验（999）。

name.en: Plan review final construction inspection and operating permit
name.zh: 图纸审查施工终验与经营许可证

agency.en: Maricopa County Environmental Services Department, Plan Review and Construction Program
agency.zh: 马里科帕县环境服务局 图纸审查与施工项目组

when.en: Three inspections: plumbing at about 20% (rough plumbing), equipment at 50–75%, and the final at 100% with the city's Final or Certificate of Occupancy. Water, sewer and permanent power must be on for the final. After it passes, pay the annual operating permit fee, then open.
when.zh: 共三次检查：约 20% 时检查给排水粗装，50%–75% 时检查设备安装，100% 完工并取得市政终验或入住许可证后进行终验。终验时必须已通自来水、污水管和永久电源。终验通过后缴纳年度经营许可费即可开业。

book.en: Request inspections in Maricopa County's Permit Center, which handles reviews, inspections and invoice payments. The Plan Review and Construction Program is at 602-506-6824, ENVPlanreview@maricopa.gov.
book.zh: 在马里科帕县 Permit Center 平台预约检查（该平台办理审图、检查和缴费）。图纸审查与施工项目组电话 602-506-6824，邮箱 ENVPlanreview@maricopa.gov。

lead.en: Apply for plan review 6–8 weeks before construction starts. If completion is within 15 business days of submitting plans, an expedited review and its fees are required.
lead.zh: 开工前 6–8 周申请图纸审查。如提交图纸后 15 个工作日内就要完工，须申请加急审查并缴纳加急费。

feeNote.en: Plan review application fees are paid in the Permit Center when you apply; the annual operating permit fee is paid after the final, before the permit issues.
feeNote.zh: 图纸审查申请费在 Permit Center 提交申请时缴纳；年度经营许可费在终验通过后、许可证签发前缴纳。

failNext.en: No permit is approved while required items are missing, a CDC risk factor can't be corrected on the spot, there is live pest activity, exterior openings lack barriers, a needed variance or HACCP plan isn't approved, or construction is incomplete.
failNext.zh: 如缺少规定项目、存在无法当场纠正的 CDC 风险因素、有活体虫害、外部开口缺少防护、所需的豁免或 HACCP 计划未获批准，或施工未完成，均不予批准许可证。

item.en: Final menus are submitted, with consumer advisories where needed.
item.zh: 已提交最终菜单，并在需要时注明消费者提示。

item.en: Approved water, sewer, electric and gas service is on and working.
item.zh: 经批准的自来水、污水、电力和燃气均已接通并正常使用。

item.en: A properly sized water heater meets peak demand, and hot and cold (or tempered) water is under pressure at every sink and fixture.
item.zh: 热水器容量足以满足用水高峰，所有水槽和用水设施均有压力冷热水（或调温水）。

item.en: There are enough accessible hand-wash stations, each with soap and paper towels.
item.zh: 洗手台数量充足、方便使用，均配有洗手液和擦手纸。

item.en: Backflow devices are installed, tested and certified, with a separate water line for chemical systems at the mop sink.
item.zh: 防回流装置已安装、测试并取得合格证明，拖把池处的化学品系统使用独立水管。

item.en: All equipment is NSF or commercial grade, installed and fully working, including cold holding, warewashing, prep and mop sinks.
item.zh: 所有设备为 NSF 认证或商用级，已安装并完全可用，包括冷藏、洗碗、备餐水槽和拖把池。

item.en: Finishes are substantially complete, gaps and penetrations are sealed, and countertops are an approved solid surface.
item.zh: 装饰基本完成，缝隙和穿孔均已封堵，台面为经批准的实心材料。

item.en: Every stipulation in the “Notification of Construction Authorization with Conditions” letter is addressed.
item.zh: 《附条件施工授权通知》中的各项要求均已落实。

item.en: You have the city's Final Inspection or Certificate of Occupancy, or the fire department's green tag, where required.
item.zh: 已取得市政终验或入住许可证，或在需要时取得消防部门绿色标签。

item.en: No pest activity, and exterior openings are protected with air curtains, screens or self-closing doors.
item.zh: 无虫害，对外开口装有风幕机、纱窗或自闭门等防护。

item.en: At least one Certified Food Protection Manager is on staff to be on site during operating hours, if you serve open TCS food.
item.zh: 如供应需控温控时的散装食品，至少有一名持证食品安全经理在营业时间在岗。

name.en: Routine food inspection and voluntary grade card
name.zh: 例行食品检查与自愿评级卡

agency.en: Maricopa County Environmental Services Department, Environmental Health
agency.zh: 马里科帕县环境服务局 环境卫生处

when.en: Unannounced, after you open. The first operational inspection by your district inspector comes soon after the permit issues.
when.zh: 开业后不定期突击检查。许可证签发后不久，片区卫生检查员会进行首次营业检查。

book.en: You don't book routine inspections. At each inspection the person in charge decides whether to take part in the grading system.
book.zh: 例行检查无需预约。每次检查前，现场负责人可决定是否参加评级。

scoring.en: Grading is voluntary and decided before each inspection; non-participants show “Not Participating.” Grades count Priority (P) and Priority Foundation (Pf) violations: A = 0 P and 0 Pf; B = 0 P with 1–4 Pf, or 1 P with 0–2 Pf; C = 0 P with 5 Pf, 1 P with 3–4 Pf, or 2 P with 0–2 Pf; more than that is D. Any legal action or permit suspension means D. Cutting Edge Program partners get A+ when they earn an A.
scoring.zh: 评级为自愿参加，每次检查前决定；不参加的显示“Not Participating”。等级按优先违规（P）和优先基础违规（Pf）数量判定：A 为 0 项 P 且 0 项 Pf；B 为 0 项 P 加 1–4 项 Pf，或 1 项 P 加 0–2 项 Pf；C 为 0 项 P 加 5 项 Pf、1 项 P 加 3–4 项 Pf，或 2 项 P 加 0–2 项 Pf；超出则为 D。凡涉及法律行动或暂停许可证一律为 D。“Cutting Edge”项目合作商户获得 A 时记为 A+。

failNext.en: Each violation comes with a correction deadline and repeats are flagged. A pattern of non-compliance can lead to County legal action or permit suspension.
failNext.zh: 每项违规都有整改期限，重复违规会被标注。持续不合规可能导致县政府采取法律行动或暂停许可证。

item.en: The person in charge is a Certified Food Protection Manager, on site during all hours of operation, with the certificate visible or accessible.
item.zh: 现场负责人为持证食品安全经理，营业期间始终在岗，证书张贴或可随时出示。

item.en: Every food-handling employee has a Food Handler's Certificate kept at the establishment.
item.zh: 所有接触食品的员工持有食品从业人员证书，并存放在店内。

item.en: Employees wash hands when required (a Priority item).
item.zh: 员工在规定情形下洗手（优先项）。

item.en: Hand sinks have soap and paper towels (a Priority Foundation item).
item.zh: 洗手池备有洗手液和擦手纸（优先基础项）。

item.en: A sign reminds employees to wash their hands.
item.zh: 张贴提醒员工洗手的标识。

item.en: Refrigerated TCS food is held at or below 41°F and frozen food at 0°F.
item.zh: 需冷藏的控温食品保持在 41°F 或以下，冷冻食品保持在 0°F。

item.en: Cooked food that needs to be held hot stays above 135°F.
item.zh: 需热保温的熟食保持在 135°F 以上。

item.en: Food comes from approved sources, is cooked adequately, and equipment isn't contaminated.
item.zh: 食品来源经批准，烹饪充分，设备未受污染。

item.en: Equipment fixed to walls is sealed at the joint so it can be cleaned and doesn't harbor pests.
item.zh: 固定在墙上的设备与墙面接缝已密封，便于清洁、不藏虫。

item.en: No roaches, rodents or other vermin, and outer openings are protected.
item.zh: 无蟑螂、老鼠等虫害，对外开口有防护。

name.en: Fire system inspection, testing and maintenance (ITM)
name.zh: 消防系统检查、测试与维护（ITM）

agency.en: City of Phoenix Fire Department, Fire Prevention Section
agency.zh: 凤凰城消防局 防火科

when.en: After you open, on a fixed cycle. Licensed contractors inspect your systems and file the reports in The Compliance Engine; Fire Prevention follows up on deficiencies and also does general fire inspections.
when.zh: 开业后按固定周期进行。由持证承包商检查消防系统并将报告上传至 The Compliance Engine 平台；防火科跟进问题，并另行开展一般消防检查。

book.en: Hire a licensed third-party contractor for the system inspections. Fire Prevention: 602-262-6771, PFD.Prevention@phoenix.gov; ITM questions to PFD.ITM@phoenix.gov.
book.zh: 系统检查须聘请持证第三方承包商。防火科电话 602-262-6771，邮箱 PFD.Prevention@phoenix.gov；ITM 相关问题发送至 PFD.ITM@phoenix.gov。

failNext.en: An assigned fire inspector contacts the responsible party and sets compliance deadlines. Repairs to deficient systems need a Fire Inspection, Testing and Maintenance (FITM) permit from the Fire Department, or a Planning and Development permit if told to.
failNext.zh: 指派的消防检查员会联系责任人并设定整改期限。修复有缺陷的系统须向消防局申领 FITM 许可，或按指示向规划与发展局申领许可。

item.en: Staff check the hood suppression system weekly: caps in place, system pressure normal.
item.zh: 员工每周目视检查排烟罩灭火系统：喷嘴盖齐全、系统压力正常。

item.en: A contractor inspects the hood suppression system every 6 months and tests it every year.
item.zh: 承包商每 6 个月检查一次排烟罩灭火系统，每年测试一次。

item.en: The hood is cleaned on a schedule set by use: every 6 months typical, every 3 months for heavy use.
item.zh: 排烟罩按使用频率清洗：一般每 6 个月一次，高强度使用每 3 个月一次。

item.en: Sprinklers get a quarterly visual check (gauges, leaks, damage), which staff can do.
item.zh: 喷淋系统每季度目视检查一次（压力表、渗漏、损坏），可由员工完成。

item.en: A contractor does the full annual NFPA 25 sprinkler inspection, and the 5-year internal inspection when due.
item.zh: 承包商每年按 NFPA 25 全面检查喷淋系统，到期时进行五年内部检查。

item.en: Staff check the fire alarm panel weekly for troubles, and a contractor tests every device each year.
item.zh: 员工每周检查火警面板有无故障，承包商每年测试所有设备。

item.en: Third-party inspection reports are submitted into The Compliance Engine.
item.zh: 第三方检查报告已上传至 The Compliance Engine 平台。
